The gain from vin2 is the clear symptom. The non-inverting divider R4/(R3+R4) sets it, and the 38.4 kΩ value of R4 gives a2 ≈ 0.073 instead of ≈ 0.0039. For matched gains, R4 ≈ R3·Rf/(R1+Rf) ≈ 1.9 kΩ, so R4 is about 20× too large. The mismatch between bw1 and bw2 also points to the vin2 path, since R4 sets the input pole at node p. The bandwidth shortfall is a secondary symptom that may partly come from the op-amp, so M5 (tail current) and Cc are the next candidates.
